Collected required details for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, Washington from Microsoft Careers.

Job selected (title contains "Applied Scientist"):
- Title: Applied Scientist II / Senior Applied Scientist - Responsible AI (CoreAI)

Requested fields (from visible evidence):
- Job number: 200017828
- Work-site arrangement (labelled as Work site): 3 days / week in-office

Two key responsibilities (from the Responsibilities section):
1) "Conduct supervised fine-tuning of LLMs, applying Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback in the process, and conducting thorough evaluation of those."
2) "Work with tech lead on the design and implementation of Agent adversarial evaluations and safety mitigations, enabling agent creators to identify potential risks and apply appropriate safeguards to ensure the safety and security of Agents."

Two preferred qualifications (from the Preferred Qualifications section):
1) "Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research) OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research) OR equivalent experience."
2) "2+ years of science experience owning feature design, model development, evaluation and deployment."

All reported values are taken directly from the visible job details on the Microsoft Careers page without signing in or interacting with apply/save/cart functionality.
